patch_list: Disables Firebase analytics, performance and crash uploads, Clarity recording, advertising identifiers and publisher session/paywall/open-notification events while retaining weather requests and notification delivery.

Uses Pro client controls while keeping map and forecast requests within Free limits. Includes Disable tracking and Hide AI insights. Purchases and server entitlements remain unchanged; paid data may be unavailable.
Reports RainViewer's original certificate digest to Firebase/Google API package restrictions after re-signing. Does not forge Google Play Integrity tokens or suppress publisher server rejection.

Uses RainViewer's no-attestation fallback and renews its anonymous app session once, preserving settings and purchase records. Includes original-certificate compatibility for Google services. Does not forge signed Google verdicts or hide p…
Disables map, forecast, sharing, post-play and post-premium advertising, in-house promotions and chart promo blocks, including cached and remotely enabled placements.
Removes the forecast AI tab and summary panel, retaining the normal temperature forecast. Stops automatic assistant requests.
Removes the Weather Warnings map-layer control and stops its overlay downloads. Keeps weather warnings delivered as part of ordinary forecasts.
Skips the automatic Google UMP consent request and banner after disabling ads and tracking. Does not record or grant consent.

Skips subscription onboarding, automatic startup/web promotions, recurring purchase offers and Settings offer cards. Hides the Settings plan Manage link while retaining the plan badge and premium access state.
